messages:
Olivia (CSM): Kicking off BlueHorizon onboarding thread. Quick intro: 30d objectives are API integration + basic prod traffic, SSO cutover, p95 latency target < 250ms for core retrieval, and a 90%+ correctness rate on their validation set. Listing primary owners and known risks.
Rina (BlueHorizon PM): Hi all Rina here. I'll own product acceptance. Core success metrics: intent extraction F1 >= 0.92 and search MRR uplift >= 12%. Were aiming for beta release by day 21.
Sam (BlueHorizon Infra): Sam Infra lead. Our IdP is OIDC at https://id.bluehorizon.io/. We need Redwood's outbound IPs and a brief maintenance window for DNS cutover. Preference: Sun 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Diego Solutions Eng here. Proposed plan: week1 connector + SSO smoke, week2 E2E bench + relevance tuning, week3 final acceptance + enablement. I'll spin up a sandbox and share creds. Need labeled eval (100-200 examples) by day 7.
Olivia (CSM): I'll coordinate workshops: Tech deep-dive (1.5h), Prompts lab (1h), Support handoff (30m). Tentative dates next Tue/Wed. Also creating a 6-question weekly feedback form for pilot users.
InfraBot: sandbox provisioned: bluehorizon-pilot-sbx v1.2 at 1799012380 (credentials email pending)
Diego (Solutions Eng): Got the sandbox notice. Question: do we want request-level cost tags for pilot logs? Could help map spend to features.
Rina (BlueHorizon PM): Yes please. Add per-route metadata so we can attribute cost to Search vs Assistant flows.
Sam (BlueHorizon Infra): We'll open egress to these CIDRs: 35.201.12.0/32 and 35.201.12.1/32. Confirm which exact IPs your service will use.
Olivia (CSM): Action items: Olivia -> send allowlist + feedback form link; Diego -> upload curl examples + sandbox keys; Rina -> share labeled eval set + product acceptance doc; Sam -> confirm maintenance window + OIDC metadata. Renewal risk: if pilot retention < 40% of target by day 21, mark as medium risk and set steering call.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Example curl I'll add to the shared doc:
```\ncurl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BH_SBX_KEY" \\n  -d '{"input":"Extract total amount from invoice #456"}' \\n  https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\n```
Rina (BlueHorizon PM): One ask: can we disable prefix/KV caching for the first 14 days? We want raw outputs to validate correctness before caching masks differences.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Agree. We'll start with caching OFF, then enable with a canary profile after acceptance. I'll also add a simple converging prompt set for relevance tuning.
Olivia (CSM): Noted. I'll record enablement and drop the recording in their onboarding folder. Also setting up daily 10min stand notes in this thread for the first 14 days.
Sam (BlueHorizon Infra): Maintenance window confirmed: Sun 02:00-03:00 UTC. OIDC metadata posted to shared doc.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Uploaded initial bench logs and a short runbook for local validation. Also adding a small script for automated latency checks: 
```\n#!/bin/bash\nfor i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BH_SBX_KEY" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate > /dev/null; done\n```
Rina (BlueHorizon PM): We'll deliver the labeled eval set (150 examples) by EOD Fri. Thanks team, excited to get going.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks everyone 44D I'll send invites, the Typeform, and the acceptance criteria doc. Check-in scheduled for day7 bench results.
